_comment: How rtc-ship.sh ships THIS repo (run-to-completion's bin/rtc-ship.sh). Data lives here; commands a repo needs live in .rtc/*.sh, opt-in by presence. Adding this file is config-only: no version bump, no release. Plain repo (no .claude-plugin): the version lives in VERSION, there is no plugin to refresh and no release assets — the Homebrew tap (haiggoh/homebrew-tap, hourly bump-formulas) picks up each new tag/release.
